title: Literary genre profile (Layer 2 — functional roles)
description: Functional-role vocabulary for LITERARY documents (Project Gutenberg novels, drama, poetry, epistolary fiction). A role is an OPTIONAL second label on a layer-1 block; each role declares the layer-1 kind(s) it may attach to.
$comment: Literary-content profile. Every role.attaches_to is non-empty. See docs/architecture/block-ontology.md#adoption-status.

x-roles.label: Epigraph
x-roles.description: Opening quotation set before a chapter/section.

x-roles.label: Verse
x-roles.description: A stanza or run of verse lines set as a block (poetry, songs embedded in prose).

x-roles.label: Dialogue line
x-roles.description: A line of quoted character speech.

x-roles.label: Speaker label
x-roles.description: A drama speaker tag naming who speaks the following line(s).

x-roles.label: Scene break
x-roles.description: A thematic scene break within a chapter.

x-roles.label: Letter block
x-roles.description: An embedded letter/telegram/document in epistolary or quoted form.
